body:
> Captured with the product owner, 2026-10-29. Not shaped yet. Its model part (a feature with its ICE) is owed.

**Story:** a person runs the Learn loop to find where the product model has drifted from what was built, and to fix the model.

Serves business intent #606 (Garura's agentic lifecycle runs as five loops). Part of #594 (loop recipes); a play of the Learn loop, whose recipe #611 decides (it names a drift step).

## Why

The product model falls behind the work. Features are found and built during a plan (#931), stories are filed straight in the tracker (#976 on 2026-10-29), and plans are closed without the model being touched. Agents decide from the model, so a model that is out of date leads them wrong. The product owner, 2026-10-29: "product model may be out of date... next we review for drift and fix the model... this is a feature under the learn loop."

## What a person can do

- Run a review that compares the product model with what was built and with the tracker, and lists every place they disagree: a feature built or filed with no page in the model, a page that says something the work no longer does, a link that is missing or wrong.
- See each finding in plain words, with what the model says and what the work shows.
- Approve the fixes, and have them written into the model by the plays that own each part.

## Done when

- The review names every place the model and the work disagree, and each finding says where it comes from.
- After the person's yes, the model is fixed and a second review finds nothing.
- What was built is the ground truth: the model is brought up to match it, not the other way round (decided under #437, 2026-06-11).

## Not in scope

- Drift between Phoenix memory and Garura's source (#949).
- Deciding the whole Learn loop's recipe (#611).

## History

An earlier skill, `check-drift`, compared the code with locked specs. Its play was never built; the stub was deleted on 2026-06-09, and the skill is no longer in the source. A later name for the play was `/reconcile`. The name of this play follows the harness standard when it is built.
title: The Learn loop finds where the product model has drifted from what was built, and fixes the model
